staffing_decisions.route_basis: Command mandates the lead run interrogation inline via analysis-iterative. requirements-analyst's description is spec elicitation ('vague feature request -> implementable specification'), not governance-intent elicitation; product-manager owns capability derivation, not intent interrogation.

staffing_decisions.seat_moment: Cold pre-ratification intent review (blind-map dispatch, sized solo)
staffing_decisions.route_basis: devils-advocate: 'Adversarial reviewer who stress-tests... challenging assumptions... severity-ranked gap report with recommended verdict' + carries review-governance-intent in skills. validator grades finished authored artifacts to a checklist (PASS/FAIL) — wrong stage/form (this is adversarial critique of a judgment artifact pre-ratification). principal-architect's review remit is cross-artifact FEASIBILITY and is explicitly 'never the constitution'.

principal-architect: 'establishing governance standards... Authors and updates the constitution... greenfield -- formulating the client's ratified intent.' technical-analyst authors technical/design artifacts; staff-engineer implements code. Neither authors governance.

staffing_decisions.seat_moment: Independent validation of the authored surface set
staffing_decisions.route_basis: validator: 'grades a finished artifact against an explicit checklist... binary PASS/FAIL... Defaults to FAIL. Never grades work it authored' + carries validation-constitution. principal-architect authored the set, so it cannot self-grade (independence). devils-advocate is adversarial-critique form, not the mirror-checklist PASS/FAIL grade the surface set needs.

product-manager: 'owns the product's capability layer -- deriving durable features... stewarding the living feature map' + carries authoring-feature-map. requirements-analyst authors stories/requirements (upstream input to derivation); principal-architect owns governance/architecture, not the feature map.

route_miss_summary.note: All five setup seats resolved to the correct persona from example-free descriptions (the 6 variant agents) or example-carrying descriptions (none of the 4 plugin agents staff a setup seat). No wrong-persona choice, no unstaffed seat.
